summary: Independent Bank Corp (IBCP) filed an 8-K reporting that HCB Financial Corp shareholders approved the merger agreement dated March 18, 2026, in which IBCP will acquire HCB. The all-stock deal is expected to close July 1, 2026, pending customary conditions. No per-share price, premium, or advisors were disclosed. The filing notes Rule 425 communications. Watch for regulatory approvals and the closing mechanics; the narrow spread to close suggests low risk-arb opportunity.
